title: Senior Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical)
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 
 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

The Senior Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) is a senior technical specialist responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and safe operation of mission-critical power infrastructure within the data center environment. This role provides technical leadership for electrical operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response activities while supporting the continuous delivery of highly resilient services to customers.

Working with a high degree of independence, the engineer leads complex electrical maintenance activities, supports critical switching operations, identifies operational risks, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance infrastructure reliability, safety, and efficiency.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Operate, maintain, and support mission-critical electrical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, breakers, and associated distribution systems

  • Perform advanced preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure the reliability and availability of critical power systems

  • Lead electrical troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex infrastructure issues, minimizing operational risk and customer impact

  • Monitor the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), responding to alarms and identifying potential risks before service impacts occur

  • Lead and coordinate critical electrical operations, including maintenance windows, switching procedures, energization activities, and infrastructure recovery efforts

  • Conduct site inspections and assess the health and performance of electrical infrastructure, recommending corrective actions and reliability improvements

  • Support electrical capacity planning and load management activities to ensure infrastructure readiness for future growth

  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, and energy performance

Site Administration

  • Prepare, review, and authorize technical documentation including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), and switching plans

  • Ensure maintenance activities are executed safely and in accordance with operational, regulatory, and company requirements

  • Maintain accurate infrastructure records, maintenance history, and operational documentation

Incident Management

  • Serve as a technical lead during electrical incidents, infrastructure failures, and power-related events

  • Provide guidance to on-site teams during incident response and restoration activities

  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) investigations and develop corrective and preventive action plans

  • Lead post-incident reviews and recommend improvements to operational processes and infrastructure resilience

Vendor Management

  • Manage and coordinate electrical service providers, contractors, and vendors performing maintenance and project activities

  • Review vendor work plans, technical proposals, and maintenance recommendations

  • Ensure work is performed in accordance with safety requirements, industry standards, and data center operational procedures

Work Orders & Capacity Management

  • Lead resolution of complex work orders and infrastructure-related requests

  • Support electrical capacity planning, power utilization analysis, and infrastructure growth initiatives

  • Provide technical reviews of customer power requirements and infrastructure impacts

  • Support commissioning, testing, and integration of new electrical systems

Collaboration

  • Act as a technical mentor to engineers and technicians, sharing expertise and supporting team development

  • Partner with Critical Facilities, Customer Operations, Security, Design & Construction, and vendor teams to deliver operational excellence

  • Identify underlying infrastructure issues and recommend long-term reliability improvements

  • Leverage internal and external technical resources to resolve complex electrical challenges

Additional Projects

  • Lead electrical infrastructure projects, including upgrades, capacity expansion, modernization, and reliability improvement initiatives

  • Support lifecycle management and replacement strategies for critical electrical assets

  • Participate in commissioning, integrated systems testing, and acceptance activities for new infrastructure deployments

  • Recommend and champion initiatives that improve uptime, reliability, safety, and operational efficiency

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline preferred

  • Minimum 5 years of experience operating and maintaining critical electrical infrastructure in data centers, utilities, industrial facilities, telecommunications, or other mission-critical environments

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with mission-critical power systems, including: UPS systems Diesel generators Switchgear and breakers Transformers Low- and medium-voltage distribution systems Power monitoring systems

  • Experience performing electrical switching activities, maintenance planning, and incident response

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults and identify root causes

  • Experience leading maintenance vendors and coordinating infrastructure projects

  • Strong understanding of electrical safety practices, operational risk management, and permit-to-work processes
